verdict.rationale: Adding managed AI features to a generated app is a fair question for an AI app builder, but the evidence describes no built-in LLM or agent capability for the user's own app that avoids provider keys. Bolt's Standard/Max agents and model routing power Bolt's own building workflow, and AI image generation creates assets during the build. 'Interact with third-party APIs' and Supabase edge functions imply the user would wire up and manage provider credentials themselves.
